experiment: Phase 4 Module 1 - SAM2 Bbox Refinement on top of Plan A

method.base: Plan A (Phase 2.5) predictions on HERIDAL val
method.refinement: SAM2 (sam2_hiera_small) bbox-prompt -> mask -> refit tight bbox
method.filtering: drop bbox if mask area < 50 px or aspect ratio outside [0.2, 5.0]

conclusion: SAM2 zero-shot bbox-prompt does NOT improve Plan A on HERIDAL. mAP@0.5 essentially unchanged, but stricter-IoU metrics (mAP@0.75, mAP@0.5:0.95) drop significantly.
diagnosis_hypotheses: SAM2 refit boxes are tighter than HERIDAL GT (GT has ~2-3 px margin around person)
For ~30 px persons typical in HERIDAL, sub-pixel scale matters: 2-3 px tightening drops IoU below 0.75 threshold
SAM2 occasionally segments only a part of the person (e.g., torso, missing limbs occluded by vegetation), producing too-small refit boxes
PAD_REFIT_PX=1 outward padding is insufficient to compensate
future_work: Sweep PAD_REFIT_PX in {2, 3, 5} px - may recover mAP@0.75
Scale-conditional padding: more padding for smaller bboxes
Try sam2_hiera_large (better quality at cost of inference time)
Use SAM2 only as FP filter (drop) rather than refit, keep original Plan A bbox
